mapper.select: select * from class_time_slot where class_id = #{classId} order by week_day, start_slot
select ts.* from class_time_slot ts inner join enrollment e on ts.class_id = e.class_id where e.student_id = #{studentId} and e.status = 'ENROLLED' order by ts.week_day, ts.start_slot

select ts.* from class_time_slot ts inner join enrollment e on ts.class_id = e.class_id inner join course_class cc on cc.class_id = ts.class_id where e.student_id = #{studentId} and e.status = 'ENROLLED' and cc.term_id = #{termId} order by ts.week_day, ts.start_slot

select ts.slot_id, ts.class_id, ts.week_day, ts.start_slot, ts.end_slot, cc.class_time, cc.location, c.course_name, u.nick_name as teacher_name, t.term_name from class_time_slot ts inner join enrollment e on ts.class_id = e.class_id inner join course_class cc on cc.class_id = ts.class_id left join course c on c.course_id = cc.course_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = cc.teacher_id left join term t on t.term_id = cc.term_id where e.student_id = #{studentId} and e.status = 'ENROLLED' and t.is_active = 1 order by ts.week_day, ts.start_slot
